new_libraries.name: AyresTimer
new_libraries.author: Daniel Cristian Salgado (AyresNet)
new_libraries.sentence: Professional 64-bit Hardware and Software Timer suite for ESP32 by Daniel Cristian Salgado (AyresNet).
new_libraries.paragraph: Total professional replacement for millis(). Features 64-bit microsecond precision, silicon hardware timer groups (TG0/TG1), high-resolution software timers (esp_timer), thread-safe FreeRTOS task callback dispatching, real-time jitter telemetry, pause/resume state control, and zero-overhead AyresTimeout and AyresStopwatch modules.
